messages.subject: Re: Order L-49363
messages.text:
Hi Luis,
 Your reaction on July 15 was fair. We told you the refund would be handled that day, and it was not. That is the second promise we broke to you, and I am not going to explain it away.
 Your full refund of $9.55 is being processed. It goes back to the card you paid with; expect a few business days before it shows on your statement.
 You ordered on April 21. You asked for a refund on May 13. It is now the end of August. Nothing about that is defensible, and you were right to say so.
 Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
